verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Stripe sends payouts to a bank account and that in-person and online payments can be managed together in the Dashboard. Neither of these is a reconciliation capability. Nothing in the pack documents itemized transaction reports, fee reports, or matching daily takings against payouts, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can reconcile daily takings against payouts with itemized transaction and fee reports
